integrity: A complete analytic proof and reproducible exact-rational checker are supplied. The checker corroborates the sharp example; the all-size theorem is proved analytically. Earlier Bernstein sign variation theory is explicitly attributed, and residual unindexed-literature risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Sharp root count and local stability only for the defector–protector edge of the specified deterministic replicator game. No complete full-simplex phase portrait, global basins, stochastic persistence, or independent originality certification.
title: A sharp three-coexistence bound on the protection edge of a quorum public-goods game
